subject: prd/tech-design-brainstorm
statement: When a branch cannot yet be phrased as a precise question, the skill shall park it as a fog entry typed by what it blocks — blocking when it sits on the chosen direction or a design-template decision-shaped input (the §2 Decision, seam placement, the Serves set), non-blocking when the design document can carry it as its own open question — and while blocking fog remains, the skill shall recommend needs-investigation rather than ready-for-design.
rationale: honesty about ignorance, retargeted at the design contract (#D-5)
fit_criterion: on under-specified fixtures, zero fabricated directions; every seeded gap is typed; blocking fixtures end needs-investigation
